capabilities: Assemble a post by recursively inlining standalone links and embeds
Upload embedded images and videos and attach them to the post
Reflow wrapped lines and short paragraphs into running prose with smart formatting
Schedule posts to a connected platform at a chosen date and time
Write a record copy of the sent post beside the source note
disambiguation: Not a blog or static-site publisher; it schedules posts only to social platforms connected through the ZettelCasting service.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The README documents exactly which requests go to zettelcasting.com and states nothing is sent until a publish command runs. The plugin is unreviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian notes built from wikilinks and embeds don't translate to social posts, and Obsidian offers no way to schedule posts to connected social platforms.

relations.evidence: The ZettelCasting plugin fully supports Santi Younger's Branch Writing plugin for Obsidian
The note assembly logic (bake() and most of src/util.ts) is derived from Easy Bake

requires.name: ZettelCasting account with a connected social platform

summary: Publishing client that assembles a note with its linked and embedded notes and media, then schedules it to social platforms via the ZettelCasting service.
